events.text: The company was founded by the SAS Group as a hotel.
The company became a listed company.
The global headquarters of Rezidor relocated to Brussels, Belgium.
The company began franchising the Radisson brand from Carlson Companies.
The company began franchising other brands from Carlson Companies.
Carlson Companies acquired 25% of the shares of Rezidor Hotel Group from SAS Group.
SAS Group ceased to be a shareholder of the company.
Carlson Companies acquired control of the listed company.
Rezidor Hotel Group started to integrate with Carlson Hotels, Inc.
Carlson Rezidor was one of the top hotel corporations.
Carlson Hotels, Inc. and its subsidiaries were sold to HNA Group.
Rezidor Hotel Group AB was renamed to Radisson Hospitality AB.
Radisson Hotel Group was sold to a consortium led by Jin Jiang International.
SAS Group opened their first hotel in Copenhagen, Denmark.
The hotels were spin-off as a separate division.
The division became a subsidiary known as SAS International Hotels.
The future President and CEO of SAS International Hotels joined the company as a junior manager.
The future President and CEO was promoted as the president and CEO.
The company struck a franchise deal with Carlson Hotels.
Rezidor SAS Hospitality was a wholly owned subsidiary of SAS Group.
The subsidiary was known as SAS International Hotels until this year.
Ritter became President & CEO of the subsidiary and the headquarters were relocated to Brussels.
Rezidor SAS signed a partnership agreement with Carlson Hotels Worldwide.
SAS International Hotels signed an agreement with Radisson Hotels International.
SAS International Hotels signed an agreement with Radisson Hotels International according to the Financial Times and Rezidor.
Radisson SAS was known as Radisson Blu.
The franchise agreement was renewed and added three more brands.
Rezidor signed an agreement to convert seven former Holiday Inn hotels in Germany to Park Inn.
Six of the former Holiday Inn hotels were converted to the Mercure brand.
Rezidor SAS opened four more Radisson hotels in the Republic of Ireland.
Two Park Inn hotels were opened in Dundalk and Mulranny.
Park Inn Dundalk was closed down.
The former Park Inn Dundalk was under the Ramada brand and managed by Lester Hotels.
Rezidor opened a Park Inn hotel in Baku.
SAS Group floated Rezidor SAS Hospitality as Rezidor Hotel Group AB on the Stockholm Stock Exchange.
SAS Group ceased to be a shareholder of Rezidor Hotel Group.
Carlson Hotels increased its ownership ratio of the Rezidor Hotel Group to 50.1%.
Carlson and Rezidor sold the brand Regent.
It was announced that Carlson hotel group and Rezidor hotel group would run hotels under the name Carlson Rezidor Hotel Group.
Carlson Rezidor Hotel Group was one of the top hotel corporations.
Carlson–Rezidor group was acquired by HNA Group.
Carlson Hotels, Inc. was renamed to Radisson Hospitality, Inc.
Rezidor Hotel Group was renamed to Radisson Hospitality AB.
The Belgian subsidiary was renamed to Radisson Hospitality Belgium SPRL/BVBA.
The trading name of the whole hotel group was renamed to Radisson Hotel Group.
